meta.desc: Homepage of the clothing designer producing 100% made-in-Quebec garments, designed by TIM students with the help of designs created by artificial intelligence and made with 100% natural and organic fibers.

acceuil.amorceAchat: T-shirts, hoodies, and caps made in Quebec 💯
acceuil.amorceH4: /** with a little help from DALL-E 😉 **/
acceuil.para1: Today, the T-shirt is an essential garment in everyone's wardrobe. And in an era when environmental concerns are more important than ever, we prefer T-shirts made in Quebec to reduce our environmental impact and highlight local craftsmanship.
acceuil.para2: V-neck, crew-neck, loose or fitted T-shirts, with short or long sleeves for those who feel the cold, plain or patterned to add style to an outfit... The T-shirt is available in a variety of colors, styles, and patterns.
